versions.content: Communication Management shall provide an API to send events and triggers to other applications Description: Application developers shall be able to provide data in form of events or triggers to other applications. Rationale: After offering a service, it shall be possible to send events of the respective service to all subscribed applications. Dependencies: – Use Case: Application “A” sends the power on event upon turning the key in the ignition lock. Supporting Material: –
